title.zh: Strategy公布2026年第三季度财报：净利润195.3亿美元、持有848,517枚比特币，CFO将离任
title.en: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任

current_state.zh: Strategy posted record Q3 2026 results with $20.91B operating profit and $19.53B net income on $20.91B of digital asset gains, disclosed 848,517 BTC held (up 26% YTD) alongside $14.33B of YTD Bitcoin purchases and $2.04B of STRC repurchases, and announced that CFO Andrew Kang will step down on November 5 with operations EVP Reza Virasteh taking over on January 1, 2027.
